painted_visibility.definition: Canvas paint completion observations; not sensor time or click success. Hidden-duration tracking excludes user-hidden overlays and absent/unaccepted-empty batches.

candidate_preview.definition: Candidate eligibility follows source/field/calibration identity; no independent per-frame alignment or timing-driven overlay pause.
